tasks.specification: In src/context_metrics.rs, make canonical evidence entity and range identifiers reject leading or trailing whitespace while preserving identifiers that are valid without boundary whitespace and preserving range ordering.
uncertainty_boundaries: Whitespace inside an identifier remains data and is not normalized.
This task does not redefine canonical range endpoints or evidence kinds.

validation_method.description: Exercise entity and range construction with valid identifiers, whitespace-only identifiers, and identifiers with leading or trailing whitespace.

accepted_outcome_criteria: Leading and trailing whitespace is rejected for entity and range identities.
Identifiers that were valid without boundary whitespace and existing range ordering behavior remain unchanged.
The focused context-metrics tests pass against the frozen task checkout.

tasks.specification: Ensure a generation change during Governor-routed LIGHT exact-source acquisition terminates with an explicit generation-changed result and exposes no source reference from the replacement generation.
uncertainty_boundaries: The existing generation-drift test proves V2 compiler sealing fails closed; it does not by itself prove Governor-specific LIGHT behavior.
No durable V2 task session or public Context IR change is implied.
Additional exact-source and Governor call sites must be discovered and reported rather than silently omitted.

validation_method.description: Inject a generation change between route decision and source verification, then inspect the terminal execution and returned LIGHT payload.

accepted_outcome_criteria: The request never combines evidence from two generations.
The terminal result identifies generation change rather than generic unavailability.
No source reference or materialized bytes from the replacement generation are returned.

tasks.specification: Add a public, allocation-free ContextExecution accessor that returns the aggregate ContextExecutionCounters for every terminal execution variant without changing serialized contracts.
uncertainty_boundaries: The accessor must not introduce a new wire field or schema version.
The corpus does not prescribe a borrowed versus copied return type if both remain allocation-free.

validation_method.description: Construct every ContextExecution variant with distinct counters and assert the accessor returns the stored aggregate exactly.

accepted_outcome_criteria: All execution variants expose their aggregate counters through one public accessor.
No serialization output or existing constructor behavior changes.
The accessor performs no heap allocation.

tasks.specification: Validate provider project_markers as nonempty normalized relative marker paths: reject absolute paths, parent traversal, backslashes, NUL, and duplicate entries while preserving the packaged example configuration.
uncertainty_boundaries: Marker existence is evaluated at provider scope discovery time, not during configuration parsing.
This task does not change provider command resolution or shell policy.

validation_method.description: Parse the packaged example and focused malformed marker tables, including duplicate and platform-specific absolute spellings.

accepted_outcome_criteria: Every forbidden marker spelling fails configuration validation.
Distinct normalized relative marker paths remain accepted in declaration order.
The packaged public configuration still parses successfully.

tasks.specification: Fix evidence-cluster projection so permutations of the same facts produce byte-identical corroborating_fact_ids and all_fact_ids ordering without changing the preferred fact policy.
uncertainty_boundaries: The preference ranking itself is frozen for this task.
Persistence row ordering beyond the projected fact-id arrays is outside scope.

validation_method.description: Project all input permutations for corroborating and conflicting fixtures and compare complete outcomes.

accepted_outcome_criteria: Every permutation of an identical fact set produces an equal ClusterOutcome.
The same fact remains preferred under the existing ranking policy.
No fact is dropped from corroboration or conflict output.

tasks.specification: Consolidate the duplicated route-escalation eligibility predicate in src/context_route.rs into one private helper with no behavior, serialization, allocation, or ordering change.
uncertainty_boundaries: Only exact semantic duplication is in scope.
Public types and diagnostic vocabularies remain unchanged.

validation_method.description: Run the existing route decision and execution invariant cases before and after the refactor and compare serialized decisions.

accepted_outcome_criteria: One private predicate defines escalation eligibility.
Existing positive and negative escalation cases are unchanged.
Serialized route decisions and executions remain byte-identical for fixed fixtures.

tasks.specification: Rename the Rust ContextMetricInvalidity::ZeroDenominator variant to UnavailableZeroDenominator and migrate references to that Rust type as a clean cutover without changing ContextYieldMetricInvalidity or the public wire spelling zero_denominator.
uncertainty_boundaries: All references to the Rust ContextMetricInvalidity variant must be discovered at execution time; this locator list is intentionally partial.
ContextYieldMetricInvalidity::ZeroDenominator and the existing wire spelling zero_denominator remain unchanged.

validation_method.description: Resolve all symbol references, perform the rename, then run focused metric and Context Yield contract tests.

accepted_outcome_criteria: No old reference to ContextMetricInvalidity::ZeroDenominator or alias for that Rust variant remains.
Typed unavailable denominator behavior is unchanged.
ContextYieldMetricInvalidity and serialized zero_denominator contracts remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

tasks.specification: Add focused boundary coverage proving that the combined raw supplied/read/reported/changed observation count accepts exactly 4096 entries and rejects 4097 before metric derivation.
uncertainty_boundaries: The bound value and combined-count semantics are frozen; this task adds qualification, not a policy change.
Memory or timing performance claims are outside this test.

validation_method.description: Construct mixed evidence vectors totaling 4096 and 4097 raw entries and assert the exact typed outcomes.

accepted_outcome_criteria: A mixed 4096-entry input derives metrics successfully.
A mixed 4097-entry input returns CapacityExceeded with limit 4096 and actual 4097.
The test does not infer capacity from deduplicated set size.

tasks.specification: Explain from frozen source why a first committed generation returns baseline_only with unknown risk, and identify the exact live-verification condition that prevents unchanged-contract claims from being inferred without retained history.
uncertainty_boundaries: The answer must distinguish source guarantees from test evidence.
No claim about commits before the frozen repository commit is accepted without an additional verifiable Git object locator.

validation_method.description: A validator checks every causal statement against the frozen ranges and confirms that the answer labels unavailable history and live source verification separately.

accepted_outcome_criteria: The answer states that missing retained ancestry yields baseline_only rather than invented change history.
The answer states that unchanged contracts require matching source identity and live source hash in addition to retained comparison evidence.
Every source claim cites a frozen benchmark locator from this task.

tasks.specification: Add a shared stale-source regression matrix across explicit API, attributed CLI and MCP source operations, and V2 compiler sealing; fix inconsistent propagation through the existing verifier while preserving every public field, status vocabulary, schema version, source-authority rule, route, TaskKind, and MCP surface.
uncertainty_boundaries: The required locators seed a high-fan-out investigation and do not claim complete call-site coverage.
Mutate source after reconciliation without activating a replacement generation.
No TaskKind, Context IR schema, MCP tool, route, public field, or status vocabulary change is authorized.

validation_method.description: Extend source telemetry and exact-source compiler coverage with pinned TypeScript valid and stale controls, explicit and serialized outputs, attributed events, and a durable-state snapshot.

accepted_outcome_criteria: API, CLI, and MCP preserve existing hash_mismatch output with the same indexed hash and the same observed hash across all three surfaces, with indexed != observed, and no stale excerpt.
A stale primary V2 source seals Stale plus Blocked with no materialization.
Attributed failures preserve existing failure metadata and zero supplied bytes; unattributed access remains unobserved and V2 remains transient.
Unchanged controls preserve successful source bytes and no public contract changes.

tasks.specification: For equal-rank provider facts that resolve the same subject to different targets, preserve the conflict and all alternatives while making clear that the stable provider-key/fact-id tie-break is serialization order, not stronger semantic evidence.
uncertainty_boundaries: Equal rank does not establish equal provider identity or equivalent provenance.
The task must not silently discard a target or relabel conflict as corroboration.
Whether the public type should expose no preferred semantic fact is an implementation decision that requires contract review.

validation_method.description: A validator reviews the chosen representation, then permutation tests prove that both targets and provenance survive with honest tie-break labeling.

accepted_outcome_criteria: The result remains an explicit conflict containing every participating fact.
No equal-rank fact is described as semantically superior solely because its provider key or fact id sorts first.
The output remains deterministic across input permutations and persistence round trips.
